title: 雾金之城
direction: One inhabited 18th-century fantasy city, revealed by the camera. A new bronze bell carried on a navy-flagged canal barge briefly stops a burgundy mail coach at a low mechanical bridge.
world: X east-west, Y north-south, Z up, metres. Canal x=-9..9 in a low valley; bridge deck z=3.1 at y=18. Terraced mountain city rises on both banks, cathedral on a 32m platform west/north of bridge; west upper districts reach 100m+, east working quays stay low. Shared terrain function for streets, foundations and moving actors.
protected: horse and wheel motion tied to travelled distance

shots.reads: Spire, dome and clock tower emerge over a fixed foreground hill; city spreads beneath.
Follow roofs northwards; cathedral, canal and workshops share one world.
Waterwheel, working quays; identify navy-flagged bell boat and approaching mail coach.
Signal, stop, lift, bell barge passes; raised deck remains clear.
Deck settles, gate opens, coach crosses; camera accompanies it then rises.
Reveal inhabited city to horizon, main subjects continue and merge into daily life.

concept_feedback: Flat and regular mountain concepts rejected. Implemented organic old-city fabric based on actually viewed historic Prague aerial photographs and period paintings: irregular perimeter blocks, narrow lanes, inner courts, varied rooflines, ridge palace and cathedral terraces. Continuous production authorized.
audio: Original sampled orchestral chamber score with strings, oboe/flute, harpsichord, horn and restrained foley. Actual listening unavailable at setup.
